detail: Rights Issue - Shanti Gold International Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 31, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 19 : 295, i.e 19 Equity Shares for every 295 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 215 per share.
